description: Defines the 'Fence' class for synchronization primitives in Android, including methods for managing fence file descriptors, waiting, merging, and retrieving signal times.

classes.name: Fence
classes.description: Represents a synchronization fence with methods for managing and querying fence status.

methods.name: Fence()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an invalid fence.

methods.name: Fence(int fenceFd)
methods.description: Constructs a Fence object managing a given fence file descriptor.

methods.name: Fence(base::unique_fd fenceFd)
methods.description: Constructs a Fence object managing a unique fence file descriptor.

methods.name: isValid()
methods.description: Checks if the fence has a valid file descriptor.

methods.name: wait(int timeout)
methods.description: Waits for the fence to signal up to the specified timeout.

methods.name: waitForever(const char* logname)
methods.description: Waits indefinitely for the fence to signal, with logging.

methods.name: merge(const char* name, const sp<Fence>& f1, const sp<Fence>& f2)
methods.description: Merges two fences into a new fence that signals when both are signaled.

methods.name: merge(const String8& name, const sp<Fence>& f1, const sp<Fence>& f2)
methods.description: Merges two fences with a String8 name.

methods.name: dup()
methods.description: Returns a duplicate of the fence file descriptor.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns the underlying fence file descriptor.

methods.name: getSignalTime()
methods.description: Returns the time when the fence signaled.

methods.name: getStatus()
methods.description: Returns the current status of the fence.
